current_house_position.explanation: Start from 2022 (BJP 255, SP 111, ADS 12, RLD 8, NISHAD 6, SBSP 6, INC 2, JSDL 2, BSP 1). By-elections moved Rampur, Kundarki, Katehari and Milkipur from SP to BJP, Majhawan from NISHAD to BJP, Khatauli from BJP to RLD, Suar from SP to ADS, and Duddhi from BJP to SP. Deaths have left five seats vacant: Faridpur (BJP), Ghosi, Duddhi and Nizamabad (SP) and Rasara (BSP's only seat). That gives BJP 257 and SP 104 by the label they were elected on. Of the 104, four have been expelled by SP and back the NDA (Manoj Kumar Pandey, now a BJP minister; Rakesh Pratap Singh; Abhay Singh; Pooja Pal), leaving 100 effective SP MLAs. Two more (Vinod Chaturvedi, Rakesh Pandey) are listed as rebels but not expelled. Total 398 sitting plus 5 vacant = 403. This matches Wikipedia's 18th Assembly table (BJP 257, SP 100, 4 SP rebels with NDA, 5 vacant). Wikipedia's 2027 election page gives slightly different figures (BJP 258, SP 101) and was not followed.

notes: NDA: BJP with Apna Dal (Soneylal), NISHAD Party, RLD and SBSP. RLD joined the NDA and the state government in March 2024; SBSP also got a cabinet berth then.

SP and Congress say their INDIA bloc alliance holds for 2027 but seat-sharing is unresolved. Congress has asked for about 150 seats; an SP MP said 50 (October 3, 2026). Talks were expected to start later in October 2026. Akhilesh Yadav says winnability will decide seats.
BSP will contest alone: state president Vishwanath Pal said the party's alliance is 'with the people' (July 30, 2026).
Aazad Samaj Party (Kanshi Ram) of Chandrashekhar Azad has announced candidates for 45 seats, per Wikipedia (Amar Ujala, July 31, 2026). AAP and Jansatta Dal (Loktantrik) also plan to contest.

key_issues.detail: Opposition makes unemployment its main charge; SP and Congress raised youth unemployment again in the August 2026 Monsoon Session.
Inflation is a standard SP and Congress line of attack against the BJP government, raised in the Assembly in August 2026.
Opposition alleges embezzlement of Ram Mandir donations in Ayodhya and wants the SIT report made public; it dominated the August 2026 session.

Special Intensive Revision cut the roll from 15.44 crore (October 2025) to a final 13.39 crore on April 10, 2026, with over 2 crore names removed; Akhilesh Yadav accused BJP of trying to game the rolls.
The 2025 'pairing' (merger) of low-enrolment primary schools drew protests; SP calls it a conspiracy against poor children and ran 'PDA Pathshala' classes in response.
SP's 'PDA' (backward classes, Dalits, minorities) pitch, which helped it beat BJP 37 to 33 in UP Lok Sabha seats in 2024, against BJP's Hindutva and welfare plank under Yogi Adityanath.
Fertiliser availability, farmers' concerns and electricity supply listed by the opposition among issues for the August 2026 session.
BJP campaigns on its crackdown on gangsters; opposition points to crimes against women. The Pooja Pal episode (praising action against Atiq Ahmad) shows the theme's pull.

key_issues_note: Issue framing is a summary written for this page, based on the cited reports; it is not from a single survey.

timeline.event: BJP wins 255 of 403 seats (NDA 273); SP 111, RLD 8, SBSP 6, INC 2, BSP 1.
Yogi Adityanath sworn in for a second term at Ekana Stadium, Lucknow.
Satish Mahana elected Speaker of the 18th Vidhan Sabha.
BJP wins Rampur by-election after Azam Khan's disqualification; RLD takes Khatauli from BJP.
SP's Sudhakar Singh beats Dara Singh Chauhan (BJP) by 42,759 votes in the Ghosi by-election.
Seven SP MLAs cross-vote in the Rajya Sabha election, costing SP one of its three candidates.
First cabinet expansion: four ministers inducted, including SBSP chief Om Prakash Rajbhar and RLD's Anil Kumar.
Lok Sabha results: SP 37 and Congress 6 of UP's 80 seats, BJP 33. Same day, BJP holds three of four assembly by-elections; SP takes Duddhi.
Mata Prasad Pandey becomes Leader of Opposition after Akhilesh Yadav moves to the Lok Sabha.
NDA wins 7 of 9 by-elections, taking Kundarki and Katehari from SP.
BJP's Chandrabhanu Paswan wins Milkipur (Ayodhya) by-election from SP.
SP expels three MLAs (Manoj Kumar Pandey, Rakesh Pratap Singh, Abhay Singh) for backing BJP; Pooja Pal expelled on August 14.
Ghosi MLA Sudhakar Singh (SP) dies; first of five vacancies that remain unfilled.
Union minister Pankaj Chaudhary declared UP BJP president.
Final electoral roll after SIR: 13.39 crore voters, over 2 crore names removed.
Second cabinet expansion: six BJP ministers including Bhupendra Chaudhary and Manoj Pandey; council reaches 60.
Rasara MLA Umashankar Singh, BSP's only legislator, dies; BSP left with no MLA.
Seat-sharing rift: Congress seeks 150 seats, an SP MP offers 50; talks due later in October.
Congress names Aradhana Misra 'Mona' UP Congress president, Imran Masood working president.

result_2022.note: Khair fell vacant when Anoop Pradhan 'Valmiki' (BJP, MoS Revenue) was elected to the Lok Sabha from Hathras in June 2024. In 2022 Pradhan won Khair with 139,643 votes over Charu Kain (BSP, 65,302).
